stem: What does the author mean when he writes, “Dr. V is simultaneously the fellow villager that he once was, and continues to be, and the extraordinary healer he has become”?

options.label: A
options.text: Despite his success and great importance, Dr. V remains humble.

options.label: B
options.text: People have only recently become aware of Dr. V’s extraordinary work.

options.label: C
options.text: It is remarkable that Dr. V functions as both a village leader and medical savior.

options.label: D
options.text: Dr. V’s hospital is reminiscent of a village, and he is the leader.
